_: Who the works are. One place, so that adding one is an act of description
rather than an archaeology through eight files.
Everything here is read by the site (assets/site.js, injected when served),
the painting host (art/render.html), the server (/state/meta.json) and the
morning painter (scripts/gen-state.js). A work that is described here and
has a painter is a work the whole site knows about.
canvas      the size the painter composes for. The shape of the work is
this, not a number repeated elsewhere: ratio = w / h.
ground      the colour the work dissolves into when the body falls
silent — its own canvas, sampled from the painting.
silence     'over'   the fade is laid over the finished picture, live,
from today's gap — so it can never be stale;
'within' the work dims from the inside (a pulse inside the
mark) and only its engine can paint it.
listed      false: live and complete, but nothing leads to it and search
engines are told to leave it alone. How a work is watched in
its real conditions before it is shown.
rule        what the page of laws says for this work. `seed` replaces the
seventh law — the one place the works genuinely part.

87.title: Variation 87
87.medium: Software, lived time written daily by an unchanging rule, screen. Dimensions variable — continuous since 2022.

rule.seed: The seed of a day is drawn from the artist’s name, the date, and the day’s record together; no two days can coincide.

89.title: Variation 89
89.medium: Software, lived time written daily by an unchanging rule, screen — in the format of a portrait. Dimensions variable — since 2025.

rule.seed: The seed of a day is drawn from the day’s record alone; the date plays no part in it. Two days of the same body make the same painting, however far apart they fall.

archipelago.title: Archipelago
archipelago.medium: Software, a sleeping body written nightly by an unchanging rule, screen. Dimensions variable — the rule since 2026, the nights since 2022.

laws: The painting is made from that night’s record of one sleeping body, and from nothing else.
A night is painted only after the body has woken.
A night is weighed against the nights of this body that came before it, never against the nights that follow.
Several signals drive every visible feature, so that no single one can be read back out.
The hours awake are not drawn. They only part what is drawn.
The instrument’s own verdict on a night is used nowhere in the work.
The seed of a night is drawn from that night’s record alone; the date plays no part in it.
The same night always makes the same painting.
A night that has been painted is never repainted.
When no night arrives, the last painting is held. From the second night of silence it goes out from within.
When the nights resume, the painting returns.
Every night the work has lived is kept.
rule.seed: The seed of a night is drawn from that night’s record alone; the date plays no part in it.
rule.foot:
First recorded night {birth}.
The rule was written in 2026; the nights it reads begin in 2022, because the body had already been recording them.
The full conditions of this work are set out in the document that constitutes it: Conditions of the Work.
